label: S. 5441
title: TAS Act

items.snippet: The bill also expands the U.S. Tax Court’s authority and establishes standards for certain paid tax return preparers.
The bill expands electronic tax return filing and requires the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) to digitize paper tax returns and correspondence.

items.item: National Taxpayer Advocate and IRS Office of Appeals
items.snippet: …various penalties for the unauthorized disclosure of tax return information, expands the authority of the National Taxpayer Advocate and IRS Office of Appeals, makes changes to the IRS Whistleblower Program, requires a study and report on requirements applicable to…

…expands the authority of the National Taxpayer Advocate and IRS Office of Appeals, makes changes to the IRS Whistleblower Program, requires a study and report on requirements applicable to foreign financial accounts, establishes within…
…responsibilities of Business Child Care Liaison, and imposes on the IRS certain requirements applicable to taxpayers experiencing economic hardship.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

C000880.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
C000880.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
C000880.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
